g.text: "ChatGPT can make mistakes. Check important info."
A fact you can look up. But does the conclusion follow?
Verification: does the result meet the requirements we set?
If it rains, the ground is wet.
The sprinkler was on: premises true,
If it rains, the ground is wet.
Every step follows a rule a computer
can check. That is proof theory.
This works however the AI found the argument. Picking the system and
formalizing the argument are still on us.
